title: Application to buy land for new parks in Queens CD2
summary: This approves a City Planning Commission decision letting the Department of Citywide Administrative Services and Parks Department acquire dozens of privately-owned properties across Queens Community District 2 for future park development. The goal is to close the "walk to a park" gap in the district. The Council held a public hearing on July 22, 2026 and found the action would have no significant environmental impact.
